declarations.docstring: Elements generated by the localization element map to units under the map associated with an invertible matrix.
Associates an invertible matrix with an algebra homomorphism of the indicated localization.
The localization map associated with an invertible matrix agrees on polynomial images with the displayed polynomial transformation.
The maps attached to a product of invertible matrices compose in the corresponding order.
The map attached to the identity invertible matrix is the identity algebra homomorphism.
Packages the general linear group action on the indicated localization as a representation.
Evaluating the representation on a polynomial image gives the polynomial transformation displayed in the formal statement.
The underlying endomorphism of the representation is the localization map attached to the same invertible matrix.
The representation sends the inverse of the localization element to the indicated inverse-determinant scalar multiple.
The polynomial map associated with a matrix sends the localization element to its determinant-scaled value.
Associates a matrix with an algebra homomorphism from the polynomial algebra to the indicated localization.
On every polynomial, this homomorphism is the algebra-map image of the associated polynomial transformation.
